entities.name: Query CoaBC candidate
observations: 406-aa query sequence; 47.6% identity and 92.4% coverage to reviewed Vibrio cholerae CoaBC Q9KVD1 (E=4.68e-98), supporting a bifunctional CoaBC annotation by homology.

Likely catalyzes phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligase (EC 6.3.2.5) and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.36) steps of CoA biosynthesis; this is homolog-based, not direct assay evidence.
Sequence Pfam matches: Flavoprotein PF02441 residues 4–176 and DFP PF04127 residues 188–399.
Predicted unmodified sequence properties: 406 aa, 43,543.8 Da, pI 6.055, instability index 31.952, GRAVY -0.0096.

entities.name: CoaBC Q9KVD1
observations: Reviewed Vibrio cholerae CoaBC catalyzes two sequential CoA-biosynthesis reactions, EC 6.3.2.5 and EC 4.1.1.36; annotations report FMN and Mg2+ cofactors.
